title: On‑Prem GPU Pod: Space, Power & Thermal Scan (Q1 2026)
content:
Purpose:
This working worksheet collects the initial physical capacity, electrical and thermal constraints for our pilot on‑prem GPU pod (private deployments for regulated customers). The goal is to produce a rack-by-rack plan with clear headroom and integration checklist for the data hall/colo partner and facilities team.

Scope and assumptions:
- Target footprint: 3 contiguous equipment racks in a single cage for pilot 1 (expandable to 12 racks in phase 2).
- Preferred accelerator: NVIDIA H100 SXM5 or equivalent; fallback: H100 PCIe or A800 depending on procurement lead time.
- Per‑GPU peak power (planning): 700 W (SXM5). Use 600 W for steady‑state thermal planning to allow 15% safety margin.
- Node configuration: 2U servers, 8 GPUs per server (typical pod node).
- Rack power feed: dual 3‑phase PDUs, each rated 32A (per PDU). We plan to provision 2 x 32A per rack (64A total) initially; confirm with colo if busway/42U power feed required.
- Target utilization: 65% average over 30 days (batch and interactive mix). Peak burst capacity allowance: +15% for short periods.

Summary table (per rack basis, pilot config):

Rack ID | RUs available | Servers planned | GPUs / rack | Peak GPU power (W) | GPU thermal (BTU/hr) | Server overhead (W) | Total rack W | Total rack BTU/hr | PDU load (A per PDU, 208V 3ϕ)
--------|---------------|----------------|-------------|--------------------:|---------------------:|--------------------:|--------------:|--------------------:|---------------------------:
Rack-A  | 42            | 6              | 48          | 700                | 16478               | 1200               | 34200        | 116696             | 32 / 32
Rack-B  | 42            | 6              | 48          | 700                | 16478               | 1200               | 34200        | 116696             | 32 / 32
Rack-C  | 42            | 6              | 48          | 700                | 16478               | 1200               | 34200        | 116696             | 32 / 32

Notes on calculations: total rack W = (GPUs * peak GPU power) + (servers * server overhead). BTU/hr uses 3.412 W per BTU/hr conversion. PDU load assumes balanced 3‑phase distribution; requires verification with colo.

Data hall / cooling considerations:
- Each rack ~34 kW peak. Typical colos classify this as high‑power density; verify floor tile load and raised floor clearance.
- Coordinate with colo for coolant capacity: 3 racks @ ~34 kW → ~102 kW total. Confirm chiller N+1 and distribution; request cold aisle containment quote.
- Recommended: direct‑expansion (DX) CRAC with close‑coupled cooling or liquid cooling options for phase 2 to reduce power overhead and increase density.
- Airflow: plan hot‑aisle containment and return plenum capacity. Confirm perforated tile percentage and CRAC face velocity to avoid recirculation.

Physical & mechanical constraints checklist:
- Cage dimensions: need 1.2 m clear staging area and 1.0 m front clearance for rack servicing.
- Floor load: confirm tile rating >= 1000 kg per tile at location.
- Rack layout: contiguous racks A–C recommended; ensure cold aisle depth >= 1.2 m.
- Cable trays: space for two top‑of‑rack fiber trays and 2 PDUs per rack.

Redundancy and reliability policy:
- Power: dual PDUs, dual intake feeds where possible; specify automatic transfer switches in colo design for future phases.
- Cooling: target N+1 CRAC for the hall; if unavailable, specify scheduled load shedding policies and degraded performance targets.
- Networking: dual ToR switches per rack bonded to separate leafs; reserve spare fiber ports and transceivers.

Phase 2 expansion notes (12 racks target):
- Consider shift to liquid cooling pods to keep floor space and PUE manageable.
- Evaluate dedicated transformer for cage (if > 500 kW total).
- Procurement window: H100 lead times estimated 10–14 weeks; propose staggered delivery aligning with colo build schedule.

Risk register (initial):
- R1: Rack feed not sized (risk: deployment delay). Mitigation: early colo electrical survey, reserve additional feed capacity. Owner: Marcus Hale.
- R2: Cooling underprovisioned causing thermal throttling. Mitigation: instrument pilot racks with 8 thermal sensors + remote telemetry; contingency contract for portable AC. Owner: Jing Li.
- R3: Space availability mismatch between mechanical drawings and on‑site reality. Mitigation: site visit + photogrammetry before shipment. Owner: Aditi Rao.

Procurement / BOM (pilot 3 racks):
- Servers (2U, 8x GPU chassis) x18 (6 per rack).
- GPUs: H100 SXM5 or H100 PCIe fallback x144.
- PDUs dual 32A 3φ per rack x3 racks.
- ToR switches: 2x per rack (400Gbps) x3 racks + spares.
- Environmental sensors: 8 per rack (inlet/outlet temp, humidity, leak).

Estimated costs (order-of-magnitude):
- Equipment (servers + GPUs): $2.5M (pilot).
- Colo build / power install: $120k one‑time + $12k/month power/base rack rent (estimate).
- Cooling upgrades (if close‑coupled/liquid): additional $200–400k CAPEX.

Monitoring & telemetry plan:
- Install Prometheus exporters for BMC/IPMI metrics, power metrics from PDUs, and environmental sensors.
- Integrate with Redwood Console for per‑rack tokenized cost and latency dashboards. Create synthetic thermal alerts when inlet delta > 8°C.

Action items (next 30 days):
- A1: Schedule colo electrical & mechanical walkthrough (target date: 2025-11-21). Owner: Aditi Rao.
- A2: Lock final GPU model and place conditional PO (target: 2025-12-05). Owner: Procurement (cc: Marcus).
- A3: Instrumentation spec and telemetry schema draft for SRE/Observability (target: 2025-12-10). Owner: Jing Li.
- A4: Draft emergency cool‑down / load‑shed playbook with SRE (target: 2025-12-15). Owner: Priya Natarajan.

Open questions for colo partner:
- Can you provide detailed single-line electrical drawings for the cage?
- Is cold‑aisle containment available as a managed service? Cost?
- Floor tile load rating and redundancy of chilled water distribution?

Appendix — quick reference conversions and formulas:
- 1 W = 3.412 BTU/hr
- Total rack W = (num_GPUs * GPU_peak_W) + (num_servers * server_overhead_W)
- Sample PDU current (A) at 208V 3‑phase simplified: I_3ϕ ≈ P_total / (√3 * V_line) (authorize colo electrical team for exact distribution).

Notes (notes-to-self style):
- Keep this doc light; move finalized diagrams and vendor quotes into Confluence after signoffs.
- If we drop to PCIe H100 for short procurement speed, update steady thermal loads to 450W/GPU and recalc racks.

Document history: initial draft 2025-11-14 by A.Rao; reviewed by Marcus and Jing 2025-11-20; updated after electrical survey 2025-12-18; pilot integration notes added 2026-01-05.
